<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="מנחם אב_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919837_theRebbe_328" batchId="meluket-_D7_9E_D7_A0_D7_97_D7_9D_20_D7_90_D7_91_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919837_theRebbe_328__p001">
  <section v="0">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section provides the header and date for the maamar.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">With the help of Heaven.</t>
    <t s="1">Monday, Parshat Eikev,</t>
    <t s="2">the fifteenth of Av, 5747*</t>
  </section>
  <section v="1">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section explains that the greatness of the fifteenth of Av lies in the ascent after the descent of Tisha B'Av, making its lunar fullness superior.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">No.</t>
    <t s="1">There were no better days for Israel than the fifteenth of Av and Yom Kippur,</t>
    <t s="2">and the Rebbe</t>
    <t s="3">(the Rebbe Rashab)</t>
    <t s="4">of blessed memory brings in his maamar explaining the matter of the fifteenth of Av,</t>
    <t s="5">that it is stated in Pri Etz Chaim</t>
    <t s="6">that the festival of the fifteenth of Av is that then is the perfection</t>
    <t s="7">of the filling of the moon</t>
    <t s="8">[and the matters that occurred on the fifteenth of Av</t>
    <t s="9">(enumerated in the Gemara)</t>
    <t s="10">are like results from its primary matter of this day – the perfection of the filling of the moon].</t>
    <t s="11">And he notes in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="12">behold, that on the fifteenth day the moon stands in its fullness</t>
    <t s="13">is every month,</t>
    <t s="14">and nevertheless festivals were not established except for Pesach</t>
    <t s="15">(the fifteenth of Nissan)</t>
    <t s="16">and Sukkot</t>
    <t s="17">(the fifteenth of Tishrei).</t>
    <t s="18">And even more so it is not understood,</t>
    <t s="19">that from the simple language "there were no better days for Israel than the fifteenth of Av etc." it implies that it is a greater festival than all the festivals,</t>
    <t s="20">even from the festivals of Pesach and Sukkot,</t>
    <t s="21">even though these festivals are also on the fifteenth of the month.</t>
    <t s="22">And the point of the explanation in this</t>
    <t s="23">(in the maamar),</t>
    <t s="24">that the primary virtue of the filling and perfection of the moon on this fifteenth day is that the filling and perfection is after a lack,</t>
    <t s="25">that after a lack is a more elevated perfection than the perfection that is from itself,</t>
    <t s="26">as is known</t>
    <t s="27">the rule regarding ascents and descents,</t>
    <t s="28">that the ascent after a descent is an ascent higher than the level before the descent,</t>
    <t s="29">and the greater the descent is,</t>
    <t s="30">the ascent is greater.</t>
    <t s="31">And therefore the primary virtue of the filling of the moon is on the fifteenth of Av,</t>
    <t s="32">for in the month of Av,</t>
    <t s="33">the descent of the moon</t>
    <t s="34">(and Israel who are compared to the moon)</t>
    <t s="35">is a very great descent,</t>
    <t s="36">and therefore the ascent of the fifteenth of Av</t>
    <t s="37">(after the descent of Tisha B'Av)</t>
    <t s="38">is a very great ascent.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="2">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section connects the festival of the fifteenth of Av to the cessation of the deaths of the generation of the wilderness, hinting at the future redemption after the destruction.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">B)</t>
    <t s="1">And it can be said,</t>
    <t s="2">that the above matter, that the festival of the fifteenth of Av is because then is the ascent after the descent of Tisha B'Av, is also hinted in that the first matter that occurred on the fifteenth of Av is that the generation of the wilderness ceased to die.</t>
    <t s="3">For the matter of the generation of the wilderness is connected with Tisha B'Av,</t>
    <t s="4">for on Tisha B'Av it was decreed upon the generation of the wilderness that they would die in the wilderness and not enter the Land,</t>
    <t s="5">and also the fulfillment of the decree was on Tisha B'Av,</t>
    <t s="6">for on every Tisha B'Av</t>
    <t s="7">(of the last thirty-nine years that they were in the wilderness)</t>
    <t s="8">they would dig their graves.</t>
    <t s="9">And the festival of the fifteenth of Av on which the generation of the wilderness ceased to die is the ascent after the descent of Tisha B'Av.</t>
    <t s="10">And from this it is understood also regarding</t>
    <t s="11">(the primary)</t>
    <t s="12">descent of Tisha B'Av on which the Temple was destroyed, the first and the second,</t>
    <t s="13">[and particularly that also the decree of the destruction was on that same day</t>
    <t s="14">(Tisha B'Av of the first year that they were in the wilderness)</t>
    <t s="15">on which it was decreed upon the generation of the wilderness that they would not enter the Land,</t>
    <t s="16">and both decrees were for that same sin</t>
    <t s="17">(the sin of the spies)],</t>
    <t s="18">that on the fifteenth of Av a glimmer of the revelation of the future shines,</t>
    <t s="19">whose primary aspect</t>
    <t s="20">is the building of the third Holy Temple</t>
    <t s="21">– the ascent after the descent of the destruction of the first and second Temples.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
